title: A complete protocol for genome-scale analysis of replication timing in mammalian cells
protocol: For adherent cells, remove cell culture medium and replenish with fresh medium.
Add BrdU at a final concentration of 50 µM.
Incubate cells for two hours in a carbon dioxide incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Rinse adherent cells gently with ice-cold PBS twice.
Detach adherent cells using 0.2X Trypsin-EDTA for 2-3 minutes or Accutase for 3-6 minutes.
Incubate cells at 37 ºC with enzyme treatment.
Use gentle trituration if necessary to achieve a single cell suspension.
Add 5 ml of cell culture medium containing FBS if trypsin has been used to the cell culture dish or flask.
Pipette gently and transfer contents to a 15 ml round bottom tube.
Count the number of cells collected using a hemacytometer.
Centrifuge at approximately 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant carefully and resuspend cells in 2.5 ml of ice-cold PBS containing 1% FBS.
Add 7.5 ml of ice-cold 100% ethanol dropwise while gently vortexing.
Seal the cap of the 15 ml tube with parafilm and mix gently but thoroughly.
Resuspend the BrdU-labeled, ethanol fixed cells by tapping and inverting the tube.
Transfer 4 × 10^6 - 8 × 10^6 cells to a 5 ml polystyrene round bottom tube.
Centrifuge at approximately 200 g for 5 minutes.
Decant supernatant carefully.
Add 2 ml of PBS with 1% FBS and mix well by tapping the tube.
Centrifuge at approximately 200 g for 5 minutes.
Decant supernatant carefully.
Resuspend cell pellet in PBS with 1% FBS to achieve a solution of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 1 mg/mL propidium iodide to a final concentration of 50 µg/mL.
Add 10 mg/mL RNase A to a final concentration of 250 µg/mL.
Tap the tube to mix and incubate for 20 to 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
Filter cells by pipetting them through 37 micron nylon mesh into a 5 mL polystyrene round bottom tube.
Keep samples on ice in the dark and proceed directly to FACS sorting.
Remove cell culture medium from growing cells and replace with cell culture medium containing BrdU at a final concentration of 50 µM.
Incubate cells for two hours in a carbon dioxide incubator at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Rinse adherent cells gently with ice-cold PBS twice.
Detach adherent cells using 0.2X Trypsin-EDTA for 2-3 minutes or Accutase for 3-6 minutes.
Incubate cells at 37 °C with the enzyme treatment and/or use gentle trituration if necessary to achieve a single cell suspension, as this is necessary for accurate FACS sorting.
Add 5mL of cell culture medium containing FBS if trypsin has been used to the cell culture dish or flask.
Pipette gently and transfer contents to a 15mL tube.
Count the number of cells collected using a hemacytometer.
Centrifuge at approximately 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Add 5mL of ice-cold PBS and pipette gently but thoroughly.
Centrifuge at approximately 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet in DAPI staining solution to achieve a solution of 5 × 10^6 – 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Filter cells by pipetting them through 37 micron nylon mesh into a 5 mL polystyrene round bottom tube.
Keep samples on ice in the dark and proceed directly to FACS sorting.
Run sample on FACS Aria cell sorter.
Keep all samples chilled on ice or at 4°C during FACS analysis to avoid cell cycle progression in the absence of BrdU.
Protect samples from light.
Use forward and side scatter information to select the desired population of cells to be included in the sort.
Create a histogram that plots cell count on the y-axis and DNA content (fluorochrome intensity) on the x-axis.
Select two distinct S-phase populations to be sorted into separate fractions.
Store cell samples immediately on ice in the dark until all samples have been sorted.
Sort cells into fresh 5ml round bottom tubes and keep at 4°C during sorting.
Centrifuge at 400g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Decant supernatant gently, only once.
Add 1 mL of SDS-PK buffer containing 0.2mg/mL Proteinase K and 0.05mg/mL glycogen for every 100,000 cells collected and mix vigorously by tapping the tube.
Incubate samples in a 56°C water bath for 2 hours.
Mix sample thoroughly and aliquot 200µl equivalent to approximately 20,000 cells per 1.5 mL tube.
Stop here and store samples at -20°C in the dark or proceed directly to BrdU immunoprecipitation.
Add 200µl SDS-PK buffer with 0.05mg/mL glycogen to each aliquot and proceed directly to BrdU immunoprecipitation.
Extract DNA once with phenol-chloroform, collecting the upper phase in a 1.5 mL tube.
Extract the mixture once with chloroform, collecting the upper phase in a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 1 volume of isopropanol and mix well.
Store the sample at -20°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 16.1 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and add 750 μl 70% ethanol to the pellet.
Centrifuge the sample at 16.1 g for 5 minutes at 4°C, then remove all ethanol and let the pellet dry.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μl 1x TE.
Sonicate DNA to an average size of ~0.7-0.8 kb.
Incubate sample at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Cool sample on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 60 µL of 10X IP Buffer to a clean 1.5 mL tube.
Add the denatured DNA to the tube containing 10X IP Buffer.
Add 40 µL of 12.5 µg/mL anti-BrdU antibody.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature with constant rocking.
Foil tubes to keep samples in the dark.
Add 20 µg of rabbit anti-mouse IgG.
Foil tubes to keep samples in the dark.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature with constant rocking.
Centrifuge at 16.1 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant completely.
If pellet becomes loose, centrifuge sample again to remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Several centrifugations may be necessary to completely remove supernatant.
Add 750 µL of 1X IP Buffer that has been chilled on ice.
Centrifuge at 16.1 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL digestion buffer with freshly added 0.25 mg/mL proteinase K.
Incubate samples overnight at 37°C.
Add 100 µL of fresh digestion buffer with freshly added 0.25 mg/mL proteinase K.
Incubate samples for 60 minutes at 56°C.
Extract once with phenol-chloroform, collecting the upper phase in a 1.5 mL tube.

Add 0.625 µL of 20 mg/mL glycogen, 100 µL of 10 M ammonium acetate, and 750 µL of 100% ethanol and mix well.
Store at -20°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16.1 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant, rinse pellet with 70% ethanol and dry.
Resuspend the pellet in 80 µL 1X TE.
Store DNA at 4°C for up to one month.

Load 6 μL onto a 1.5% agarose gel.

Mix well.
Let the mixture stand at -20°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the mixture for 30 minutes at maximum speed and 4°C.
Rinse pellets with 70% ethanol.
Air dry the pellets.
Resuspend the pellets in 10 μL of nuclease-free water.

Follow the GenomePlex Complete Whole Genome Amplification Kit procedure from the Library Preparation step.
